sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Hollerau – firm full-volume commitment for mechanical seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to secure full supply of the 24 mm mechanical seal with a firm, long-term commitment.

Our proposal: EUR 29.89/unit, 23,400 pcs/year, 24 months, 56 days lead time, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01. If this package is agreed, the full annual quantity of 23,400 pcs is binding.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); this is not a claim about your actual cost or margin.

If this needs approval on your side, would you be willing to sponsor this package with your manager as a commercial exception? We would gladly support your internal business case with this firm commitment.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Hollerau – firm full-volume commitment for mechanical seal 24 mm
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your request for a firm commitment of 23,400 units over 24 months. 

Accordingly, we can offer EUR 31.70 per unit under the revised volume and contract terms. Our Angebot comprises a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Revised package: full volume, three-year commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for revising your quotation and confirming the full 23,400 pcs/year and 56 days lead time. We appreciate the step.

To meet you, we raise our proposed price from EUR 29.89 to EUR 30.90/unit and add a third committed year: 23,400 pcs/year, 36 months, 56 days lead time, DAP, 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01. The full annual quantity is binding in each of the three years. If this complete package is approved on your side, we would conclude on it.

Your supplier-wide rolling on-time delivery was 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3); we ask for commercial recognition of this service record in the package.

If internal approval is needed, we would be glad to support your business case with this longer firm commitment.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Revised package: full volume, three-year commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised proposal for a 36-month contract term. We have reviewed the delivery record you cited; it does not justify a commercial adjustment.

Consequently, this is our letztes Angebot. We offer a price of €31.40 per unit for the extended commitment of a volume of 23400 pcs per year. Under this offer, our Lieferzeit is 56 days, and the contract term is 36 months. Please decide. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
